verdict.rationale: The pack never documents bulk operations such as multi-select edits or batch updates across many issues. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct support. The Linear Agent can "analyze feedback in bulk", which is analysis, not bulk operations on items. Filtering views, the GraphQL API and the MCP server's ability to "read and change issues" are a related feature and developer building blocks, not a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
